name: Grade 9 IIT Practice: August Week 10 - Visualization

words.definition: Data that is corrected and organized.
words.example: Clean data made the chart easier to read and trust.

words.definition: An explanation that uses data as evidence.
words.example: The data story explained why the highest category mattered.

words.definition: An image of what is on the screen.
words.example: The student added a screenshot of the finished chart as progress evidence.

words.definition: A way to open a web page or file.
